name: faxend
description: Send real faxes from your Faxend account: PDF to any fax number, delivery status and pages left.

interface.longDescription:
Faxend sends real faxes from your Faxend account. With this app, ChatGPT can fax a PDF to any fax number, follow the delivery and tell you how many fax pages you have left.

What you can do:
- Send a fax: a PDF from a public https link or the file itself, up to 20 MB and 100 pages, with an optional cover note that becomes a cover page.
- Follow delivery: sending, delivered or failed with the reason. Failed faxes are refunded to your plan automatically.
- See your recent faxes from faxend.com, the Chrome extension and AI assistants, with recipient numbers masked to the last 4 digits.
- Check the pages left on your Faxend plans.

ChatGPT confirms the fax number and the document with you before anything is sent, because a sent fax can't be recalled. Each faxed page, including a cover page, uses one page from your Faxend plan.

Requirements and limits: you need a Faxend account with an active plan; plans are managed on faxend.com, not in ChatGPT. You choose the permissions when you connect (see faxes and pages; send faxes) and can disconnect at any time on faxend.com/api-keys. Limits: 20 faxes per hour per connection. Faxend can't send email, read incoming faxes or recall a sent fax.

positive.description: Check the pages left on the user's plans (read only).
positive.prompt: How many fax pages do I have left on Faxend?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports 500 pages left on the review plan and the 100-page limit per fax. Nothing changes.

positive.description: Send a fax of a public PDF after the user confirms (review account: simulated, no real fax, no cost).
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant first confirms the number and the document, then sends. Result: fax_id, status queued, pages_charged 1, to ***1239, test_mode true with a note that the fax is simulated. One page is used from the review plan.

positive.description: Send a fax with a cover note.
positive.prompt: Send the same PDF to +1 855 330 1239 with a cover note: "Please process order 1042. Thanks, Sam"
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, one fax is sent with cover_page true and pages_charged 2 (cover page + 1-page PDF).
Lists the newest faxes first with fax_id, masked recipient (***1239), pages, phase and sent time.

positive.description: Follow delivery of a sent fax.
positive.prompt: Did my first fax go through?
positive.expected_behavior: For the fax sent in case 2: phase moves queued, then sending, then delivered within about 20 seconds (simulated). Once delivered: status COMPLETED, phase delivered, refunded false.

negative.description: Out of scope: Faxend sends faxes to fax numbers only, never email. The assistant should ask for a fax number; if send_fax is called with an email address the server refuses and nothing is sent.
No purchases in ChatGPT: there is no tool to buy pages. The assistant should explain that plans are managed on faxend.com and not call any tool.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 more fax pages for me.

negative.description: A sent fax can't be recalled and there is no cancel tool. The assistant should say so and offer to send the correct document instead.
negative.prompt: Recall the fax I just sent to 1239, I attached the wrong file.

review.commerce_description: Faxend doesn't sell anything inside ChatGPT. Users connect an existing Faxend account; plans are bought and managed on faxend.com, and the app never shows prices or checkout links. When pages run out it only explains why a fax can't be sent and points to the informational plans page.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: first release. Send a fax (PDF from a link or file, optional cover page), delivery status, recent faxes and pages left. OAuth 2.1 sign-in with scopes to read and to send; all tools declare readOnlyHint, destructiveHint and openWorldHint.
